ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) to 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-contrast white contiguous blobs located on the lateral portions of the left and right lobes, separated by a broad central black peduncle-to-notch column. The left lobe white region contains diffuse, irregular dark mottling. The right lobe white region contains distinct, isolated dark circular rings and focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 102 degrees and moderate depth relative to the fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of variations is more pronounced on the outer distal tips than the medial regions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges of the fluke lobes exhibit a convex trajectory tapering toward the tips, with a sharp concave transition at the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, dark-on-white high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) detected on the white field of the right lobe; smaller, less defined dark clusters detected on the left lobe's mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable presence of circular scarring patterns consistent with parasitic or barnacle attachment sites on both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly specific cluster of four to five dark circular rings on the right lobe forming a distinctive geometric constellation.
